items.desc: Zapisz ten filmik, przyda się przed wyjazdem 📍 🏛️ Koloseum — symbol Rzymu i jeden z 7 nowych cudów świata, 18€ (bilet łączony z Forum i Palatynem) 🏛️ Forum Romanum — serce starożytnego Rzymu, w cenie biletu do Koloseum 💶 Fontanna di Trevi — wrzuć monetę przez lewe ramię, podobno gwarantuje powrót do Rzymu, wstęp darmowy ⛪ Watykan — Muzea Watykańskie i Kaplica Sykstyńska (20-25€), Bazylika św. Piotra całkowicie za darmo 🕍 Pantheon — najlepiej zachowana budowla starożytnego Rzymu, 7€ ⛲ Piazza Navona — barokowy plac pełen ulicznych artystów, wstęp darmowy 🪜 Schody Hiszpańskie — widok na całe miasto, wstęp darmowy 🍝 Trastevere — najklimatyczniejsza dzielnica na wieczorną kolację, wstęp darmowy 🌳 Villa Borghese — park za darmo, Galleria Borghese w środku 15€ ekstra Nie chcesz sam kombinować z trasą, kolejnością i godzinami otwarcia? Mamy dla Ciebie gotowy plan dzień po dniu. Link w bio ✨ #rzym #rome #traveltok #włochy #podróże

items.desc: Stop overpaying for your trip to Rome. Here is a complete 3-day plan with official prices and honest tips to avoid the tourist traps: 🏛️ Day 1: Ancient Rome Start at the Colosseum. Only use the official site (colosseo.it) to get tickets for €18. Resellers will charge you $80+ for the same thing. Walk through the Roman Forum and end at Sant'Ignazio for the most beautiful ceiling in Rome. ⛲ Day 2: City Center Hit the Pantheon (€5) and the Trevi Fountain. If you want a photo without the crowds, you must be there by 7:30 AM. For sunset, head to Villa Borghese — it’s free and offers the best view of the city. 🇻🇦 Day 3: Vatican City Book the Vatican Museums (€20) weeks in advance. St. Peter’s Basilica is free to enter, but the line gets massive by 10 AM, so go early. Finish your trip with dinner in Trastevere for the best pasta in the city. 🍝🍷 SAVE this for your next trip! 📌 Which city should I cover next? 👇 #rome #visitrome #travel #traveltok #fyp

items.desc: Stop dreaming and start packing! Paris can be a trap if you don’t know where to go. Here is everything you need to know about the top spots: 🗼 Eiffel Tower - Skip the expensive climb. Head to Trocadéro for the best photos or Rue de l'Université for that iconic close-up. It sparkles every hour after sunset! 🏛️ The Louvre - Don't wait at the glass pyramid. Enter through the "Carrousel du Louvre" mall to save hours. It’s huge, so pick 2-3 wings max. 💃 Moulin Rouge - The birthplace of the Can-Can. It’s located in Pigalle — the area has a great nightlife vibe, perfect for a quick photo op when the neons are on. ⛪ Notre Dame - She’s finally back and open! The detail on the facade is insane. Walk around the back for a quieter, beautiful view by the river. 🛍️ Galeries Lafayette - Even if you’re not shopping, the dome is a must-see. Go to the top floor terrace for the absolute best FREE panoramic view of the whole city. 🏛️ Arc de Triomphe - Sitting at the top of Champs-Élysées. NEVER try to cross the traffic circle on foot; there’s an underground tunnel for a reason! 🎨 Montmartre - The most artistic district. Hike up to Sacré-Cœur for the views, but keep your hands in your pockets — the bracelet scammers at the bottom are persistent. 🌳 Luxembourg Gardens - Do it like a local: grab a green chair, a fresh croissant, and just people-watch by the fountain. It’s the best break from the city rush. SAVE this for your next trip! 📌 Which spot are you hitting first? 👇 #paris #fyp #viral #traveltiktok #travel
